propositions: docs/README.md combines multiple concerns (audience routing, policy, generated ownership, history) and must be refactored into a compact landing page with labeled routes for distinct reader audiences.
The documentation checker (scripts/check_docs_index.py) enforces link presence but does not classify pages by audience or detect duplicate directory entries.

All 67 maintained top-level Markdown pages must appear exactly once in a primary directory, classified under one audience route, while preserving three troubleshooting rows and three historical evidence pages at their current paths.

The landing page must remove outdated claims about six ticket relations and shared ADR numbers, and preserve discoverable entry points for CLI, MCP, adoption, contribution, and internals use without adding new validation logic.
